name: BYOM behavioral checks (streaming / structured / multi-turn / parity / concurrent / retry)
summary: Cross-cutting BYOM correctness probes on the Responses API — streaming, JSON-schema structured output, multi-turn retention, static-vs-dynamic parity, concurrency, and retry-after-429.
description: Not a Foundry feature per se — a suite of properties every BYOM path must satisfy. Each test asserts that the BYOM {conn}/{model} prefix survives a particular Responses API code path (SSE streaming, response_format=json_schema, multi-turn conversation, parallel calls, rate-limit backoff).
notes: Fills the gap between per-feature BYOM tests and end-to-end correctness. If any of these regress, the whole BYOM matrix is unreliable.
